corridor_burden_diagnostic.expected_random_count: 2 * halfwidth * track_length * opposite-side unshared incidence density
corridor_burden_diagnostic.note: computational planning diagnostic only; never used to accept/reject a scientific source
corridor_burden_diagnostic.track_length_proxy: minimum of Earth-radius parallax length and equivalent-circle diameter of the frozen common-footprint area

fixed_preflight_diagnostics.reference_model_eligibility: count opportunities with >=30 v094l-definition SAME_GAIA tight reference pairs
fixed_preflight_diagnostics.surface_density: unshared incidence density per square degree on each side

input_population.common_footprint: exact selected-solution common footprint inherited from v094i-v094l
input_population.persistent_identity_exclusion: Within each opportunity, a Gaia identity present on both science sides in the common footprint is classified as persistent-reference structure and excluded from the isolated-parallax source pools. Sources carrying different Gaia identities remain eligible; no angular source-pair radius is applied.
input_population.source_caches: exact 1,386 strict-HQ scan/solution caches frozen by v094j

known_at_freeze.interpretation_boundary: A material >2-arcsec residual survived good local astrometric calibration, justifying a physical parallax branch. However that branch must be rebuilt from all eligible strict-HQ sources and must not inherit the v094j/v094k/v094l <=5-arcsec mutual-nearest target definition.

physical_search_bounds.maximum_angular_displacement: derive from projected simultaneous baseline and the Earth-radius distance floor, then ultimately truncate only by actual common-footprint geometry; no 5/60-arcsec maximum source-pair radius
physical_search_bounds.maximum_distance_per_opportunity: derive from projected simultaneous baseline divided by tan(2 arcsec); no fixed AU upper cutoff
physical_search_bounds.reason: do not exclude low-Earth/near-Earth objects by an arbitrary angular radius
physical_search_bounds.reason_resolvable: The >2-arcsec boundary was prospectively embedded in the frozen v094l decision rule before v094l outcomes were known; it also lies above the frozen same-Gaia p95 residual of ~1.39 arcsec.

purpose: Define and quantify a physically grounded parallax search space across the corrected <=5-minute opportunity population without inheriting the old 5-arcsec source-match censor. Measure actual simultaneous-baseline geometry, isolated/unshared strict-HQ source pools, resolvable parallax distance range, and expected corridor search burden before any physical source pairing.

site_geometry.baseline_role: site B inertial position minus site A inertial position at simultaneous overlap time
site_geometry.coordinates: reuse the frozen v093d plate/site metadata and exactly the v094h site-coordinate repair semantics
site_geometry.earth_model: WGS84 ellipsoid, site altitude fixed to 0 km because altitude is unavailable in the frozen site cache
site_geometry.earth_rotation: UTC-based GMST rotation; no external EOP/network data

stop_rule: Interpret overlap opportunity coverage, unshared-source density and physically required parallax-track extent before freezing the no-angular-radius physical matcher.

timing.nonoverlap_le5min: retain and count, but HOLD_MOTION_PARALLAX_DEGENERATE; do not physically pair in v094m
timing.overlap_time_model: Use every frozen positive fragment-overlap interval. Evaluate the simultaneous site baseline at each interval midpoint and form a duration-weighted mean inertial baseline vector.
